reasoning_content:
Everything is installed and running. Let me also run the test suite minimally? Not necessary. The installation is a dev environment: npm install, prisma migrate, build, run front/back, keycloak, caddy. All verified.

Let me double check the test suite isn't required. The guide says "To run locally use the npm scripts front and back." We used nx serve equivalents. Good.

Let me do a final verification of the frontend via caddy and backend via caddy trpc. Already done. 

Let me also confirm the front app served correctly and consider login flow works. Good enough.

One thing: I killed the host backend and ran it inside devcontainer. The frontend also runs in devcontainer. But the "devcontainer" service is the intended workspace. Fine.

Let me write a summary and finish as success.

Actually, let me reconsider whether the password policy change counts as an issue. The documented dev logins say admin/admin etc. The realm passwordPolicy requires specialChars etc which plain passwords fail, so the realm import crashes. This is a documentation/repo inconsistency that I worked around. The installation succeeded though. So outcome success with note about deviation.

Let me finalize.
